scope: Read-only source audit of basic gameplay requested by user. No runtime scenarios executed and no implementation changes made.
conclusion: Basic combat, government-weighted random hostile encounters and legal labels exist. Mining and the described policing/security simulation are absent.

checks.actual: Arrival places one hostile Sidewinder when government index is below 4. Generic periodic spawning uses (randomByte & 7) > government, so anarchy is 7/8 hostile per spawn draw and corporate state 0/8. No distance-to-planet, patrol route, pirate base, traffic prey selection or pack formation.

Generic spawn runs about every 18 simulation seconds below the body cap (10 normal, 18 executive). Hostiles appear 5000 units ahead irrespective of station/planet/sun geography and pursue/damage the player. No separate deep-space population model or NPC-versus-NPC piracy.

checks.behaviour: Asteroid mining between planet and star
checks.actual: Launch creates one asteroid at a fixed local position. Periodic spawn creates Sidewinders, Cobras or cargo, not asteroid fields. Asteroid destruction removes it without ore/fragments. Mining Laser exists as equipment/damage but has no extraction rules. Cargo scooping accepts cargo or inactive Thargons; cargo always maps to commodity 0, not mined minerals.

Commander legal status exists but is not used to create police or choose pursuit targets. Viper hull exists and is referenced by a mission spawn-suppression guard, but normal spawn paths do not launch patrol Vipers. General AI has no per-NPC pursuit target or police role/state machine.

Lasers and player missile acquisition explicitly skip station targets; station-directed firing does not generate an attack incident/alarm or defensive launches. Station collision/docking checks are separate from security response.

checks.behaviour: Police investigate player shooting clean ships near station
checks.actual: No station security zone, witnesses, crime report or police investigation. Laser hit sets the victim hostile before kill resolution. Kill reward/penalty relies on current hostile flag, so an initially clean laser victim can lose the clean-kill penalty and even give the generic hostile bounty. Missile kill of a still-nonhostile victim can add legal status, but still no police response.

checks.behaviour: Police investigate an attack on player near station
checks.actual: Hostile AI directly damages the player; there is no attacker offence report, station alarm, patrol intervention, protection or NPC-on-NPC pursuit.

existing_related_features: Normal/executive equipment, combat, missiles and ECM
Cargo scooping and inactive Thargon collection
Solar fuel scooping with heat/overheat hazards (not asteroid mining)
Restricted-cargo legal marking on launch; Clean/Offender/Fugitive display
Constrictor/plans and Blackjack mission-specific encounters, independent of general police/pirate ecology

bugs.title: Clean victim becomes hostile before crime/bounty decision
bugs.trigger: Player fires laser at a clean normal ship; fireLaser sets hostile=true. resolveDestroyed uses that new flag for both bounty and legal penalty.
bugs.impact: Self-defence hostility is conflated with criminal status/first aggressor; player can avoid clean-kill penalty and obtain hostile bounty.
bugs.recommended_model: Track role, legal status/bounty, first aggressor, victim and combat intent separately. Record crime when unlawful attack occurs, not only after destruction; preserve lawful self-defence.

suggested_next_work_in_order: Separate combat hostility from legal status and record attack/destruction attribution correctly.
Add station security zone and incident/witness rules with police targets, prioritisation, response timing, reinforcements and de-escalation.
Add government- and geography-aware traffic/pirate populations, including deep-space encounters and NPC-versus-NPC interactions.
Add deterministic mineable asteroid fields between planet and star, mining-laser fragmentation and typed scoopable ore cargo.
validation_needed_for_implementation: Lawful clean victim first shot vs self-defence; crime survives victim retaliation and destruction.
Missile/laser/bomb incidents use consistent aggressor and bounty rules.
Offender/fugitive pursuit chooses actual target, including NPC criminals.
Attack station: first alarm and bounded reinforcement wave, not an unbounded spawn loop.
Attack clean craft inside/outside detection range; police help clean player under attack.
Anarchy vs lawful system and station vs lane vs deep space populations with seeded random draws.
Mining laser yields typed fragments; wrong laser, depleted asteroid, full hold and repeated collection handled.
Actor-isolated simulation ownership and make ci for implementation.
